ticket.title: Admin UX pass 2: Remote access and Integrations as guided setups, Seats & models explains itself, task order, Admin vs Settings
ticket.description:
Owner walkthrough, part 2 (m-3136ceca05). Part 1 (Settings and Teammates) is t-5dd0cc18ea; coordinate with it on shared files and don't overlap.

1. **Remote access** is a guided setup, not a bare form.
   - A numbered walkthrough: what Remote access is for (teammates, or your own phone or laptop reaching this board), then install Tailscale (per-OS link), sign in, and let this page detect it (`tailscale status`).
   - Turn on `tailscale serve` from here and show the resulting URL, then the one-line public-mode switch.
   - Each step shows done or not done, detected live.
   - Add a visual guide: diagrams or annotated screenshots per step. The owner allows a codex seat for image generation; spawn one only for the visuals and keep them in `assets/guides/`.
   - A link to a `guides/remote-access.md` guide with the same steps.
2. **Integrations:** for every integration, say in one line what it lets Heronry do, what you need (account or key), where to get it (link), and what changes once it's connected. Add a status line: not set up, connected (tested), or error with a reason. Hide or disable options that need another step first, and name that step.
3. **Seats & models:**
   - A greyed model and seat combination must say why on hover and focus, and in visible text next to it: "harness not installed", "not in this role's catalog", "effort above this model's cap" and so on.
   - The doctor seat shows a "?" icon because it has no avatar or role icon; give `doctor` a proper role icon and name ("Help").
   - Every role the board knows renders with its icon; add a test over the full role list.
4. **Reading order:** order every Admin tab and its sections the way a person works through them, top to bottom: first run and essentials first, then day-to-day, then advanced. Tabs: Services, Models, Teammates, Remote access, Integrations, Settings (advanced last). Write the order down in `web/src/pages/admin/README.md` so future tabs follow it.
5. **Admin vs Settings:**
   - Admin is for the whole install (services, models, people, access, integrations, instance settings) and is only for admins.
   - Settings is only your personal preferences (theme, avatar, notifications, your own shortcuts).
   - Make each page say so in one line at the top. Move any instance-wide control that sits on the personal Settings page to Admin, and any personal one out of Admin.
   - If after this Settings has fewer than 3 items, fold it into the account menu and remove the page. Report which you did.

Commit by path with both trailers. Use vitest and private-instance screenshots (the s6_walk recipe); don't run the full web e2e suite.

criteria.text:
Screenshots from a private instance, with vitest, show Admin UX pass 2 (owner m-3136ceca05).
- **Remote access:** a numbered Tailscale setup with live done/not-done per step and a visual guide.
- **Integrations:** every item says what it does, what it needs and where to get it, with a tested status.
- **Seats & models:** every greyed combination shows its reason in visible text. The doctor seat renders as "Help" with an icon, and a test covers every role's icon.
- **Order:** Admin tabs and sections follow the documented task order in web/src/pages/admin/README.md.
- **Admin vs Settings:** each page states its scope in one line, with no instance-wide control on personal Settings.
